text:
marie_sales: Heads up - Lakeside Finance POC kickoff is next Monday. They requested SOC 2 one-pager, an ISO scope excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation letter, and temporary staging credentials. They need these items before the demo. Can we confirm what we can share for a short POC vs full enterprise handover? Need answers by Tue EOD.

ajay_se: short answer: we can provide a SOC 2 control summary (redacted), a one-page redacted system description, and a short-form pen-test attestation signed by security. full pen-test reports or raw scan outputs are not shared for POCs. We can also provision ephemeral API tokens for the demo tenant with a TTL.

sophie_sec: I can sign the attestation. Important: we need exact wording from sales re: scope (hosted vs private). For hosted/demo environment we'll include language that the eval environment is isolated and contains no production customer data. We do not issue vendor-signed ISO certificates for ephemeral trials - only the ISO scope excerpt and control mapping.

marie_sales: they confirmed POC will use synthetic data and only need hosted demo. Also asked whether we can run a 30-day dedicated trial without an annual commitment. Jordan, can you handle pricing?

jordan_onboard: Yes we can provision a 30-day dedicated eval as a metered trial with a spend cap and optional support hours, no annual commit required for the eval. I'll open a finance approval ticket; needs billing contact from the customer to finalize.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: IN-8479 - Lakeside POC: evidence + trial pricing. Assignee: jordan_onboard. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IN-8479

ajay_se: I'll prepare a small runbook for staging creds and example curl requests. Plan: 24-hour TTL tokens by default, a small sample app for embeddings and streaming, and rotation instructions. Example: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

sophie_sec: Draft pen-test attestation (short-form) to be uploaded: "Redwood Inference attests that our hosted demo environment provided for evaluation purposes is isolated from customer production environments, does not retain customer production data, and that Redwood maintains an active vulnerability management and third-party penetration testing program. This attestation is limited to the environment and dates specified for the evaluation." I'll post a signed PDF on Confluence after review.

marie_sales: who signs SOC2 excerpts or cover letters for customers? Legal asked whether signature on attestation is sufficient for procurement.

sophie_sec: security signs the attestation and the SOC2 cover letter can be provided as a redacted PDF. We don't provide the full SOC2 report to prospects; only to contracted customers under NDA.

ajay_se: flagged procurement blocker in the ticket: Lakeside procurement is asking for explicit statements about on-prem options for regulated workloads. Engineering/solutions needs to confirm feasibility and an estimated timeline for Private deployment if required.

jordan_onboard: Added preliminary pricing estimate to IN-8479: $3k-$7k for a 30-day dedicated eval (GPU hours + storage + support). Finance will confirm exact numbers.

marie_sales: next steps: sophie to upload pen-test attestation draft and SOC2 one-pager to the ticket and Confluence; ajay to prepare the staging runbook and ephemeral credentials; jordan to get finance sign-off and collect customer billing contact; i'll update Lakeside legal tomorrow. cc @luis_custops for customer confirmation.

luis_custops: Lakeside legal confirms redacted SOC2 + signed short attestation are acceptable for the POC. They requested to see the pen-test letter sample with an actual signature block.

sophie_sec: uploading draft now to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/POC+Evidence+Drafts

deploy-bot: Attachment added to IN-8479 by sophie_sec: lakeside_poc_pen_test_attestation_draft_v1.pdf

marie_sales: great, thanks everyone. I'll follow up after uploads and finance confirmation.
